datasets.attribution: European Union, Copernicus Emergency Management Service, On-Demand Mapping; activation metadata normalized by Aplomb
datasets.availabilityRule: Latest captured values; original historical availability is unproven. Gate at retrievedAt.
datasets.licence: Copernicus EMS On-Demand Mapping terms permit reproduction, distribution and adaptation with source attribution; EU ownership retained
limitations: Five activation metadata records from a paginated catalogue; not a complete global hazard inventory.
A centroid identifies the mapping activation area, not the disaster epicenter, affected boundary or damage extent.
Source activation and revision timestamps omit timezone and remain verbatim properties; display time is capture time.
No disaster narrative, casualty count, third-party imagery or product damage assessment is reproduced.
Restricted products and third-party linked information are excluded; no account or registration used.
Current capture cannot establish original historical availability, issuer exposure or financial impact.
datasets.name: Copernicus EMS public activation centroids
datasets.scope: First five public Copernicus EMS activation metadata records; source centroids only.

datasets.attribution: NASA FIRMS / LANCE, MODIS Collection 6.1 Terra and Aqua near-real-time active-fire data; no NASA endorsement
datasets.availabilityRule: Latest captured values; original historical availability is unproven. Gate at retrievedAt.
datasets.licence: NASA-led Terra/Aqua mission data: CC0 under NASA Earthdata guidance unless marked restricted; no restriction in selected CSV
limitations: Europe regional rolling 24-hour feed only; incomplete detection coverage due to clouds, orbital revisit and sensor resolution.
Thermal anomalies can include industrial heat or volcanoes; a detection is not confirmation of a wildfire.
Coordinates are satellite pixel centers, not exact fire boundaries; scan/track dimensions are retained in kilometres.
Fire radiative power is an instantaneous source measurement, not damage, area burned or financial loss.
Near-real-time data may be revised or replaced by science-quality products; this immutable version retains the captured feed.
Anonymous current file download is usable; area API still requires MAP_KEY and historical archive authentication is set aside.
Original historical availability is unproven; replay gates at capture and issuer exposure is not established.
datasets.name: NASA FIRMS MODIS Europe thermal detections
datasets.scope: Official MODIS Collection 6.1 near-real-time Europe rolling 24-hour CSV; captured feed only.

verification: Existing parsers, integrity loader, passport generator and typed World observations service exercised; no new tests.
